VAR RevenueInPipeline =
    CALCULATE (
        SUMX ( Opportunities, Opportunities[Value] ),
        FILTER (
            Opportunities,
            Opportunities[Status] = "Open"
            && VALUE(LEFT(Opportunities[Sales Stage],1)) >=2
        )
    )
VAR BaseGoal =  
MROUND(([Revenue Won]+ (RevenueInPipeline*.60)),1000000)    
RETURN
IF(BaseGoal > 0, BaseGoal, MROUND(([Revenue Won]+ (RevenueInPipeline*.60)),100000))
Probability-weighted revenue from open opportunities (opportunity value multiplied by win probability).

VAR Revenue =
    CALCULATE (
        SUMX ( Opportunities, Opportunities[Value] ),
        FILTER (
            Opportunities,
            Opportunities[Status] = "Open"
            && VALUE(LEFT(Opportunities[Sales Stage],1)) >=2
        )
    )
RETURN
    Revenue + ( Revenue * ( [Forecast Adjustment Value] / 100 ) )
Total unweighted value of open opportunities in the pipeline.

VAR Revenue =
    CALCULATE (
        SUMX ( Opportunities, Opportunities[Value] ),
        FILTER (
            Opportunities,
            Opportunities[Status] = "Open"
        )
    )
RETURN
    Revenue + ( Revenue * ( [Forecast Adjustment Value] / 100 ) )
Total revenue from opportunities with a Won status.
Average revenue per Won opportunity (Revenue Won divided by Count of Won).
